intro: Play the story in order, sweep the missables before the final mission, then clean up collectibles and activities. Chapter and mission trophies come from the story itself and cannot be missed — failed missions can be retried. The 9 trophies flagged missable are cautions built from the official descriptions: they are tied to story progress, so finish them before the finale.

stages.text: Start the story and play the missions in order. Pick up the partner trophies while your partner is around, and start the stranger strands when they appear on the map.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 1 and 2

stages.text: Keep playing the story in order. Work the five character strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) and the stranger strands alongside the missions — they are the missables, and this is when to finish them.
stages.title: Play the story — Chapters 3 and 4

stages.text: Stop before the final mission and check every trophy below. Partner trophies need your partner beside you; character finales and stranger strands can close once the story ends; story choices in Actions Speak Louder cannot always be remade. If a trophy below is still unticked, do it now.
stages.title: Before the finale — the missable sweep

stages.text: Play the final mission, then chase the game's own 100% checklist — story, strands, collectibles and activities together — with the in-game stats screen as your guide.
stages.title: The finale, then 100% completion

stages.text: Sweep Leonida region by region: 3 card sets, WAiNK at 100 locations, 100 vehicles, all 52 areas, 8 garages and 10 Scooter Bros registrations. Nothing here is missable, so take your time.
stages.title: Collectibles — cards, WAiNK, vehicles, areas

stages.text: Races, the shooting range, stunts, fishing, the arcade, bowling, meditation, hunting and the robbery trophies. Work the counts — 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 20 race wins, 50 challenges — and use the challenge menu to find what is close.
stages.title: Activities and challenges

stages.text: When the other 54 are ticked, the platinum unlocks on its own.
stages.title: Platinum

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
